content.value_statement: Influencer briefs often miss deliverables, disclosure rules, and approval steps. This skill creates structured creator-ready briefs for campaigns, platforms, timelines, compensation, and compliance.
actual_capabilities: Builds complete influencer briefs with overview, deliverables, creative direction, timeline, compensation, and contact sections.
Adapts briefs for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, feed posts, YouTube videos, and YouTube Shorts.
Includes disclosure, usage rights, approval process, revision policy, and campaign asset requirements.
Captures creator voice inputs before drafting when the brief needs to preserve a creator style.
Saves finished briefs to local memory and promotes durable campaign facts for later reuse.
limitations: It does not choose how to split budget across creators.
It needs user-provided campaign facts, dates, deliverables, and compensation terms.
It does not verify current platform specifications through live integrations by default.
It marks unregistered marketing claims for review instead of approving them.

use_cases.title: Standardize Creator Briefs
use_cases.description: Produce consistent briefs for multiple creators while keeping deliverables, dates, and disclosure terms aligned.

use_cases.title: Prepare Platform-Specific Campaigns
use_cases.description: Tailor TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube requirements without rewriting the whole brief.

use_cases.title: Onboard Ambassador Partners
use_cases.description: Document voice guidance, usage rights, compensation, and review steps for recurring creator programs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with the essential campaign facts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an influencer brief for our [campaign] promoting [product] on [platform]. Include deliverables, key message, timeline, compensation, and disclosure requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Multi-Platform Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when one campaign spans more than one platform.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a TikTok and Instagram Reels brief for [creator type] promoting [product]. Use [CTA], [posting window], [brand handle], and [hashtag].

prompt_templates.title: Complete a Brief from Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you have rough campaign notes and want missing items flagged.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a creator brief for [campaign] using these inputs: [paste campaign details]. Mark missing compliance, claim, timeline, or payment details as questions.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Ambassador Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for recurring partner programs that need reusable structure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable ambassador brief template for [brand]. Include platform variations, approval workflow, usage rights, voice guidance, and a handoff summary for related skills.

output_examples.input: Create a TikTok brief for micro-influencers promoting an organic protein powder.
output: A creator-ready brief with campaign overview, one TikTok review video deliverable, hook guidance, product talking points, and CTA.
Disclosure instructions place #ad at the start of the caption and include verbal disclosure in the video.
Timeline, draft approval, compensation, usage rights, and contact sections are included.

output_examples.input: Generate an Instagram Stories takeover brief for a launch event.
output: A Stories-focused brief with frame-by-frame deliverables, event posting window, brand tags, hashtag guidance, and review steps.
The output defines approval timing, live content link submission, insights reporting, and creator freedom boundaries.

output_examples.input: Turn these rough ambassador notes into a reusable creator brief.
output: A reusable ambassador brief with overview, recurring content expectations, voice guidance, approved claims, usage rights, and payment terms.
Missing dates, claim approvals, and payment details are surfaced as questions for the user.

best_practices: Provide campaign goals, product facts, deliverables, timeline, compensation, and required disclosures in one prompt.
Share approved claim wording before asking the skill to draft regulated product messages.
Use the creator voice intake when authenticity matters more than a strict brand script.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to allocate budgets across creators; use a budget planning skill instead.
Do not leave disclosure, usage rights, or payment terms vague for sponsored content.
Do not treat the output as legal advice for regulated claims or contract terms.

faq.question: What type of brief does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates influencer campaign briefs with deliverables, messaging, creative direction, timeline, compliance, compensation, and contact details.

faq.question: Can it create platform-specific briefs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, feed posts, YouTube videos, and YouTube Shorts.

faq.question: Does it verify legal compliance?
faq.answer: No. It includes disclosure and usage-rights sections, but legal review is still needed for regulated campaigns.

faq.question: Does it require external integrations?
faq.answer: No. It works from user-provided details and can optionally use available local campaign memory.

faq.question: Can it preserve a creator voice?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use the included voice intake structure before drafting the brief.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide brand, product, creator type, platform, deliverables, key message, CTA, dates, compensation, disclosure rules, and usage rights.
